title: Skyline Luxury - Rooftop Deck- King Suites-Garage
description:
Your luxurious vacation home has everything needed  to enjoy Nashville. 3 King-suites and a Queen bunk room, each has a full bath . A fully stocked kitchen with coffee provided for your morning cup of Jo. Smart TV's and dedicated workspaces in each bedroom. A 2 car garage, or driveway parking for our guests. A Pack' N Play is available upon request. Enjoy a relaxing start or end to your day with your favorite beverage on the rooftop terrace with amazing views of Nashville.

The space
– 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms (sleeps 10)
– Bedroom 1: Two queen bunk beds (first floor)
– Bedroom 2: King suite (second floor)
– Bedrooms 3 & 4: King suites (third floor)
– Additional sofa bed in living room
– Each bedroom has a private bathroom
– Fully equipped kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances
– Drip coffee maker + starter coffee provided
– Rooftop terrace w/ lounge seating + city skyline views
– 55" Smart HDTV
– Washer + dryer in unit
– Central A/C + heating
– Dedicated workspace
– 2-car garage + driveway parking
– Smart lock for easy self check-in

Guest access
Guest Access
– Full private access to the entire home and rooftop
– Self check-in via smart lock
– Free parking in garage + driveway

Other things to note
Other Notes
– Multi-level home with stairs to rooftop deck
– Security camera at exterior front door (active only when vacant)
– Quiet hours: 10PM–7AM
– No parties or smoking indoors
– Family-friendly: Pack ’n Play available on request
FAQ
➤ How far is downtown Nashville?
About 8–10 minutes by car or rideshare.
➤ Is parking included?
Yes, guests have access to a two-car garage and additional driveway parking.
➤ Does every bedroom have its own bathroom?
Yes! Each bedroom is a private ensuite, perfect for groups.
